exec: pm.test("30 seeds and 3 pages", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.totalElements).to.eql(30); pm.expect(b.totalPages).to.eql(3); pm.expect(b.content).to.have.length(10); });

const b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("pageZero", JSON.stringify(b.content.map(e=>e.empId))); pm.test("page 0 content", () => {pm.expect(b.content.map(e=>e.empId)).to.eql(["E001","E002","E003","E004","E005"]); pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.hasPrevious).to.eql(false);});

pm.test("disjoint pages and metadata", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.content.map(e=>e.empId)).to.eql(["E006","E007","E008","E009","E010"]); pm.expect(b.totalPages).to.eql(6); pm.expect(b.hasPrevious).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.content.map(e=>e.empId).filter(id=>JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("pageZero")).includes(id))).to.eql([]);});

pm.test("hasNext without totals", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.content).to.have.length(7); pm.expect(b.hasNext).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property("totalElements"); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property("totalPages"); });
pm.test("last slice has two rows", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.content).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(b.hasNext).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.content[0]).to.have.property("email");});
pm.test("empty page no overflow", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.content).to.eql([]); pm.expect(b.totalElements).to.eql(30); pm.expect(b.hasNext).to.eql(false);});
pm.test("Location and Unicode body", () => {pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.eql("/api/employees/E901"); pm.expect(pm.response.json().empName).to.eql("Nguyễn Thị Ánh");});

pm.test("retained Unicode and V2 fields", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.empName).to.eql("Nguyễn Thị Ánh"); pm.expect(b.email).to.eql("anh@example.com"); pm.expect(b.department).to.eql("QA");});
pm.test("updated state persisted in repository", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.empName).to.eql("Trần Minh"); pm.expect(b.salary).to.eql(15000000);});
